title: GLFWClient
author: JG
description: add ruler to renderer, only for case where axes are parallel to x, y and z (i.e. 90 degree rotations)
releaseNotes: A ruler in the render window: visualizationSettings.view0.window.showRuler or the key F5 shows scales at the bottom and the left border of an orthographic view, with ticks at 1, 2 or 5 times a power of 10; in an axis-aligned view the labels are the coordinates of the view, else the distance from the end of the scale; the raytracer draws it as well.
